notes:
Summary: VelocityGrid runs a latency-sensitive trading assistant and downstream reranker for order routing. Primary objectives: 1) keep P95 end-to-end <40ms for chat completions under expected load; 2) improve unit cost by 3-5x over current self-hosted baseline via batching/caching and quantized models; 3) deterministic fallbacks for peak traffic.

From calls: "They cannot tolerate tail spikes during market open — 50ms spikes are unacceptable." Wants a dedicated pool or private deployment behind their VPC. Interested in automated prefix/KV caching for repeated postures (market snapshot prompts). Wants SDK hooks to control batching window from client side (max latency budget setting).

Customer quoted wanting a perf matrix: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, cost per 100k tokens for each model/quantization setting. Also asked about hot-shard placement across AZs for resilience.

POC notes: initial POC uses Llama-2-13B-8bit and a quantized 4-bit 30B variant for reranking; chat uses smaller 7B micro-model for quick confirmations. SE flagged need to test KV cache effectiveness with 60s TTL and workload skew.

Sales tactic: start with Dedicated month-to-month reserved pool for market hours; trial Optimize recommendations to tune batching windows and mem-caching.

Key quotes: "If we can shave 10ms at p95 and cut token cost by half, we'll move to Dedicated."
latency_targets: P95 < 40ms (goal), P50 < 12ms; cold-start under 75ms for cached flows
throughput_targets: steady-state 200-350 req/s, bursts to 1200 req/s during open
perf_benchmark_requests: Run microbenchmarks: 1) single-token streaming latency; 2) 32-token completion p95/p99 under batching windows [5ms, 10ms, 25ms]; 3) end-to-end client->model with prefix cache hit/miss split 80/20; include GPU utilization and cost per 100k tokens for each run
quantization_goals: Support int8 and int4 quantized paths without functional regressions; compare int8 vs int4 cost/latency tradeoffs; preserve reranker fidelity (top-5 stability) when moving from fp16 to q4/q8
batching_and_caching_requirements: Need deterministic batching controls (max latency budget, max batch size) exposed via SDK; automatic prefix/KV caching with configurable TTL and eviction policy; prefer workload-aware adaptive batching recommendations from Redwood Optimize
poc_status: mid-POC: baseline benchmarks completed on customer's infra; Redwood SE to run equivalent on Dedicated H100 pool week of 2026-02-20; security questionnaire in flight
